[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended using PHP libraries or external APIs for export functions, such as PHPWord for Word documents and PHPExcel for Excel spreadsheets.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided example code for exporting a report to a PDF using the TCPDF library.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example code snippet:
```php
require_once('tcpdf/tcpdf.php');

$pdf = new TCPDF(PDF_PAGE_ORIENTATION, PDF_UNIT, PDF_PAGE_FORMAT, true, 'UTF-8', false);

$pdf->AddPage();
$pdf->writeHTML($report, true, false, true, false, '');
$pdf->Output('appraisal_report.pdf', 'D');
```
